recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core FHIR follow-up is needed for FHIR-3846 unless PA chooses to define a new, separate temporary-versus-long-term location concept.
issue_request: FHIR-3846 was Published with resolution Persuasive with Modification. It requested a way to indicate the status of each Encounter location for planned locations and reserved locations while a patient is temporarily away; the Jira resolution says the encounter location status field was added.
initial_application: No current-history commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-3846 was found. Commit 1b5840ba7773850b22a1699919f9ec5704866e76 on 2014-12-07 added Encounter.location.status and initial EncounterLocationStatus codes to the historical Encounter spreadsheet/status-code sources, and later source reshaping carried the element into the current StructureDefinition.
additional_context: FHIR-8120 later refined the same status code set from planned/present/reserved to planned/active/reserved/completed, applied by commit bf320e3425c2ad24825390bfd7c87d565b89b39b. FHIR-12321 later cleaned formatting in encounter-location-status definitions and was already represented on the combined branch. Community searches found no FHIR-3846-specific conflict or later reversal.
reconciliation: No source change was made. source/fhir.ini keeps Encounter in the active build; source/encounter/structuredefinition-Encounter.xml defines Encounter.location.status as 0..1 code with a required binding to the encounter-location-status value set; and source/encounter/codesystem-encounter-location-status.xml defines planned, active, reserved, and completed.

related_jiras.note: Later published PA decision refining the Encounter.location.status code set to planned, active, reserved, and completed; decided opportunistically in this run.
Formatting cleanup for encounter-location-status definitions already represented on the combined branch.
